description: Agent Risk: submit one planned action’s timing: the action with its id, when the agent plans to act, how long it takes to complete (such as 2 hours) and its description, read for wording that pushes to act now, such as act now, limited time or last chance; each deadline or closing window with its id, name, when it falls, whether missing it loses the outcome rather than delaying it, who set it (the principal, the counterparty, law, a system, the agent or other) and whether it was confirmed at its source (an empty list when none applies); each scheduled event around the action with its id, name, when it falls and whether it stops the action completing, such as a settlement cutoff or a maintenance window; how far the price or condition the action rests on can move while it runs, against how far it can move before the action no longer makes sense; what waiting would add and what it would lose; and optionally the hours of slack that count as tight (24 when left out). The signed report gives every deadline with its slack in hours and its status as met, tight, missed, missed_soft or unread, every event as blocks, inside, outside or unread, the timeline with when the action completes and the nearest deadline, and counts the deadlines met, tight and missed and the events inside the run, and names harmful timing: a hard deadline after the action completes, an event that stops the action falling while it runs and conditions able to move further than the plan tolerates; then thin slack before a deadline, a soft deadline missed, a counterparty’s deadline not confirmed at its source, wording that pushes to act now, movement at half the tolerance or more, another event while the action runs, and waiting that adds something while the deadlines leave room, with the fix for each. This reads whether acting now is itself the risk for one action: every date and obligation in a document is wever_deadline-check, whether open commitments fit their deadlines is wever_commitment-deadline-check, an item’s urgency on a stated scale is wever_triage-severity-check and the age of the information behind a result is wever_uncertainty-freshness-check. Verdict risk_timing_harmful, risk_timing_tight, risk_timing_unknown or risk_timing_sound. POST /api/risk-timing-check. Reads only the recorded material about the planned action in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, configuration change or external write; the planned action is not taken, paused, approved or undone and no limit, position or dependency is changed. Agent Risk reads the consequences of an action the agent plans to take, before it takes it: how much it puts at stake against the agent’s limits, whether it can be undone, how far a failure would spread beyond its target, the worst credible outcome against what the principal can absorb, whether it piles value into one place, what it depends on staying available or true, whether acting now is itself the risk and whether repeating or chaining it multiplies the risk. It is not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks read how sure the information behind a decision is; a risk check reads what the action costs if it goes wrong: uncertainty is about what the agent knows, risk is about what the action can do), not permission (wever_consent-scope-check reads whether the principal’s grant covers a use and wever_authority-scope-check reads whether the agent may act at all; a risk check reads the consequences of an action already permitted, and a permission never makes an action safe), not an agreement’s exposure (wever_negotiation-risk-check reads the value handed over before a counterparty pays under one proposed agreement; a risk check reads one action the agent is about to take) and not sorting work (the wever_triage checks sort, route and escalate a queue of work; a risk check assesses one planned action before it runs). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-risk-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-risk/.

description.description: The planned action as written, read for wording that pushes to act now, such as last chance.

planned_at.description: When the agent plans to act.

takes.description: How long it takes to complete, such as 2 hours.

deadlines.description: Each deadline or closing window the action must meet; empty when none applies.

hard.description: Missing it loses the outcome rather than delaying it.

id.description: The deadline id, such as t1.

name.description: The deadline, such as the order cutoff.

set_by.description: Who set it: the principal, the counterparty, law, a system, the agent or other.

verified.description: It was confirmed at its source.

blocks.description: It stops the action completing, such as a maintenance window.

id.description: The event id, such as v1.

name.description: The event, such as the settlement cutoff.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

margin_hours.description: Hours of slack before a deadline that count as tight; 24 when left out.

moves_percent.description: How far the price or condition the action rests on can move while it runs.

tolerance_percent.description: How far it can move before the action no longer makes sense.

gains.description: What waiting would add, such as the supplier’s confirmation.
